prompts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: actual production source key drawings for a 2D game sprite growth animation, NOT a diagram, presentation, collage of thumbnails or alternate concepts.
Input image 1 is the authoritative LEVEL 3 design. Input image 2 is the authoritative LEVEL 4 design. Match their polished hand-painted game icon rendering, dark fine outlines, coral-red fleshy mushroom cap, ivory organic cradle, red eggs, wood/rope and brass/ivory mechanisms, unchanged 3/4 front camera and light from upper left.

Draw SIX complete, discrete poses of THIS SAME spore mushroom nest, in an exact 3 columns by 2 rows grid, on a genuinely transparent 1536x1024 canvas. Each cell is 512x512. Every pose stays entirely within its cell. Fixed ground contact at local y448 and center at local x256. Keep common viewing scale; do not enlarge each pose to fill its cell. No cell borders, labels, text, numbers, arrows, glow, dust or motion trails. These are finished usable sprite drawings, not sketches.

Reading order:
A top left: LEVEL 3 SEALED. The two big ivory front cradle lobes have folded INWARD and UP into a single volumetric sealed cushion, hiding all three eggs. The organic neck has withdrawn slightly so the cap lowers (cap apex around local y130). Preserve the exact two ivory side vent nozzles, rope-bound wooden posts/collar, small brass lever and right wood bellows from level3. No new stone platform or tank. The seal is a plausible continuous fleshy fold, not an empty black gap or a pasted patch.

B top middle: LEVEL 3 MAXIMUM ANTICIPATION COMPRESSION, same exact architecture and design as A. Visibly lower, broader organic mushroom dome (apex around y165), shorter compressed neck, firmly shut cradle pressing inward, unmistakable accumulation of force. Hard nozzles, wooden posts and bellows keep their shape, moving at connections rather than bending. Keep bottom contact at y448. Distinct silhouette from A.

C top right: FIRST QUANTUM GROWTH BURST OVERSHOOT. An INTERMEDIATE architecture between level3 and4: taller organic neck and cap, apex around y65; a low burgundy/ivory circular foundation begins underneath, wooden collar/posts are partly fitted with brass rings, side vent arrangement follows same direction, retain recognizable right wood bellows with a short brass connection, no fully developed turquoise tank yet. Front cradle still sealed, no eggs visible. Soft dome has an upward follow-through stretch and lifted edge; hard parts remain rigid. This is an actual new drawn growth peak, not scaled level3. Ground y448.

D bottom left: SECOND ANTICIPATION, EXACTLY THE SAME intermediate architecture as C, now visibly compressed down with broad low dome (apex around y125), organic neck shortened and sealed cradle tense. Same foundation, same vents, same brass rings and wood bellows as C, same final footprint. No unexplained disappearance or extra pieces. This is the rebound and second force buildup after C, clear silhouette contrast with C. Ground y448.

E bottom middle: LEVEL 4 GROWTH OVERSHOOT, completely matches level4 architecture: rigid burgundy/ivory stone circular platform and front steps, brass collar, two tall ivory columns with brass fittings, ivory louvered vent nozzles, right brass wheel AND turquoise pressure cylinder. The soft ivory cradle is still firmly SEALED over the eggs. Cap and connected soft neck stretch upward in a modest growth overshoot (apex around y22, cap width around 450) while rigid platform stays grounded at y448. Keep plausible anatomy and connection surfaces.

F bottom right: LEVEL 4 HALF OPENING, same exact completed architecture as E and reference2, cap settled down to normal final height (apex around y52). Ivory front lobes part and fold outward halfway, revealing the UPPER PORTIONS of exactly three coral-red eggs behind the front lip. The interior has a red bowl and brass rim as reference2, with believable foreground occlusion. No extra eggs. Same platform contact y448. Next pose will be the unchanged original fully open level4 reference.

Priority: faithful identity, clearly different acting silhouettes and plausible folds. Keep fleshy cap, neck, cradle continuously connected. No overlapping duplicate caps, ghost contours, torn texture, missing areas, detached parts, see-through body, crossfades or full-image stretch. All six are production key drawings that will later be cropped as exact cell images.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit image 1, the SIX-POSE source sheet, retaining its six drawings and beautiful painted sprite style. Images2 and3 are authoritative original level3/4 designs. This is actual animation source art, so consistency, exact layout and genuine transparency are essential.
Return a corrected 1536x1024 RGBA PNG with 3 columns x2 rows, exact512x512 cells. NO background, NO colored haze, NO halo, NO shadows cast outside the sprites. Fully transparent empty area and fully opaque body pixels. No text/borders/numbers.

Make ONLY these targeted corrections:
1) REGISTRATION: fully contain each complete sprite in its own cell, horizontally centered localx256. Every foundation/contact bottom should land on localy448. Reserve a minimum32px clear margin at the top of each cell. In particular, bottom-middle's cap currently crosses the cell boundary: place the complete cap fully INSIDE bottom-middle, apex localy35 or lower. Do NOT individually scale every sprite to the same height; retain the intentional tall/short growth and pressure silhouettes. Shift artwork vertically to common ground without distorting hard parts.
2) INTERMEDIATE DESIGN CONSISTENCY: top-right and bottom-left represent the SAME intermediate architecture. Preserve the partly brass-fitted ivory/wood posts, brass-fitted wooden central collar, wood bellows, burgundy/ivory base and front steps visible in top-right. Give bottom-left exactly that same part inventory and arrangement, lowering/compressing its soft dome and neck. Do not revert bottom-left to bare level3 wooden posts/rope collar. Hard brass and ivory pieces maintain their volume. Top-right is stretched upward after growth; bottom-left is squashed wide before next growth. Their silhouettes must contrast strongly.
3) BOTTOM-RIGHT HALF OPENING: keep level4 machine design exactly as current. Raise the inward-folded ivory front lobes so they still obscure the LOWER TWO THIRDS of the three eggs. Only three small red egg tops should peek out through the half-open seam. Add believable overlapping soft folds and preserve continuous flesh. It must be clearly less open than the final original level4 image3. Do not show a fully open bowl.
4) Preserve the first two poses' faithful level3 parts and clear closed-vs-compressed difference. Preserve top-right and bottom-middle growth silhouettes and sealed cradles. Do not add any eggs in closed poses. Preserve all cap outlines, paint colors and mechanical detailing except for the corrections above.

No duplicate or detached parts, clipped cap, empty hole, faded body, in-between overlays, glow or motion trails.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit this ONE complete spore mushroom nest into its anticipation/compressed pose. It is an actual animation key drawing, not a design variant.
Keep EXACTLY the provided nest's intermediate-level architecture: same ivory columns with brass rings, same brass-fitted central wooden collar, same two ivory vents, same right wooden bellows, same burgundy/ivory circular foundation and front steps. Keep their shapes, positions and size and the fixed camera, palette, paint texture and outline style. Keep the front ivory cradle firmly sealed and egg-free.
Change ONLY the SOFT RED MUSHROOM CAP and connected soft neck into strong anticipation compression: press the high rounded dome down into a very LOW, WIDE, almost flat spring-loaded cap. On the reference512 coordinate system, move its apex from y30 to about y120, while keeping the cap's outer eaves near their current y180 and the machinery and base fixed. This is organic volume-conserving flattening, not global image resizing. The compressed silhouette must differ obviously from the tall reference. Preserve cap attachment and plausible continuous flesh; no detached cap or torn areas.
Use exactly the same square canvas and fixed ground position as the reference. Fully transparent background, opaque sprite. No cast shadow, background haze, glow, text, guides, arrows, duplicated body, motion smear or effects. Draw only one complete nest.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit the provided level3 spore nest into its CLOSED pose, as an actual production animation key drawing.
Preserve the original composition, scale, exact cap silhouette and apex height, neck, two side nozzles, rope posts, wooden central collar, brass lever and right wooden bellows, their positions, painterly texture, thin dark outline and lighting. No growth yet. No foundation, stairs, turquoise tank or new machinery.
Change ONLY the lower organic cradle and eggs: fold its ivory front/side fleshy lips INWARD and UPWARD, creating a softly rounded, tightly sealed cradle with three overlapping connected organic lobes. Hide all three red eggs completely behind the folded lips. Fill the interior with plausible flesh, no black hole, tears, detached body or pasted patch. Bottom ground contact remains exactly where it was. Do NOT move, raise, shrink, flatten or enlarge the red cap or upper machinery.
Keep the original square canvas with exactly the same subject framing. Transparent background. One complete sprite, no text, grids, effects, glow, smears, added shadows or duplicate parts.
